answer: Seats in violet are fixed in number; each is won at auction, paid in saffron, and returns to the pool only when its term decays out. A comet counts only while seated, so to seat n clones an attacker must evict n incumbents and cannot transfer a won seat; the kth seat clears above the kth-highest honest bid and settlement runs one term at a time, never as a batch. A thousand comets need a thousand evictions, each priced in saffron that rises with every seat taken. It fails if seats become transferable or the pool is enlarged.
